name: Weigh In
summary: A photo upload that really compresses your picture and weighs it on a kitchen scale before sending
about: Weigh In shrinks a photo in the browser before it uploads. Pick a picture (or watch the sample valley) and set the quality, the longest side and JPEG or WebP: the canvas re-encodes it on the spot, a springy needle on the kitchen scale swings to the new weight against a dashed mark for the original, and a split view lets you compare both copies pixel for pixel. Upload lifts the photo off the scale while the needle falls back to zero as the bytes leave.
how: Press Choose or drop a photo on the card; a sample valley is ready to try.
Move the Quality slider and pick a size and format; the scale and the savings update live.
Drag the divider (or use the arrow keys on it) to compare the original and the new copy.
Press Download for the smaller file, or Upload to send it and watch the scale empty.
